scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && node scripts/check-type-escapes.ts && node scripts/check-stryker-disables.ts && node scripts/check-hosts.ts && node scripts/check-agent-docs.ts && node scripts/check-changesets.ts && node scripts/check-release-workflows.ts && node scripts/generate-cli-reference.ts --check
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm -r run test && pnpm run test:scripts
scripts.test:unit: pnpm run build && pnpm -r run test:unit && pnpm run test:scripts
scripts.test:randomize: pnpm run build && pnpm -r run test:randomize && node scripts/node-test.ts unit --test-randomize "scripts/test/**/*.test.ts"
scripts.coverage: pnpm run build && pnpm -r run coverage
scripts.pkg:check: pnpm run build && pnpm -r run pkg:check && node scripts/check-declaration-docs.ts && knip
scripts.size: pnpm run build && node scripts/check-size.ts size-budget.json && node scripts/check-names.ts name-budget.json
scripts.site:build: node site/api-reference.ts && vitepress build site && node scripts/site-copies.ts
scripts.version-packages: changeset version && node scripts/record-released-codes.ts && node scripts/check-agent-docs.ts --write-versions && pnpm install --lockfile-only --ignore-scripts
